common.metric: PSNR in dB vs the analytic ground truth, pooled over the 4 patterns, camera-native RGB, interior only
common.provenance: measured on x86-64 Linux, Rust 1.99, at f0a289527b227b47f949c3f7a93b35dfe88ce110, with the fixtures in rcd_clean_baseline.rs (same analytic definitions as demosaic_quality.rs); floors = measured minus margin for cross-platform f32/libm drift
common.regenerate: cargo test -p rohditor-demosaic --test rcd_clean_baseline -- --nocapture prints measured values; verify the algorithm change against crates/reference (level1_clean_fixtures), bump algorithm_version in lib.rs, then update measured_* and floors in this file
